approval.note: yanlis pozitif: 'Hardly had... when...' notasyon farki; transkriptte 'Hardly had the results been published when' var

segments.text: Scientists studying bumblebees in Canada kept sleeping queens in small tubes of soil
segments.englishExplanation: Canadian scientists kept hibernating queen bumblebees inside small soil-filled tubes.
segments.turkishExplanation: Kanada'da yaban arılarını inceleyen bilim insanları, uyuyan kraliçe arıları küçük toprak tüpler içinde tutuyordu

segments.englishExplanation: These soil tubes were stored inside a refrigerator.

segments.text: One day they noticed that water had leaked into some of the tubes, leaving the bees
segments.englishExplanation: They eventually noticed that water had accidentally entered several of the containers, leaving the bees...
segments.turkishExplanation: Bir gün tüplerden bazılarına su sızdığını ve arıları...
tamamen su altında bıraktığını fark ettiler.

segments.text: Little did they expect what happened next.
segments.englishExplanation: They certainly did not expect the surprising outcome that followed.
Once the team drained the water away,

segments.text: the queens woke up and crawled away as if nothing had happened.
segments.englishExplanation: the queen bees revived and walked off as though everything were perfectly fine.
segments.turkishExplanation: kraliçe arılar uyandı ve sanki hiçbir şey olmamış gibi yürüyüp gitti.

segments.text: Intrigued, the team repeated the test on purpose.
segments.englishExplanation: Curious about this outcome, the researchers intentionally recreated the test.

segments.text: Not only did most queens survive a whole week underwater,
segments.englishExplanation: The majority of queens not only survived seven full days under water,
segments.turkishExplanation: Kraliçelerin çoğu su altında tam bir hafta hayatta kalmakla kalmadı,

segments.text: but they also seemed none the worse for it.
segments.englishExplanation: they also showed no signs of injury or harm from the experience.
segments.turkishExplanation: aynı zamanda bu durumdan hiç zarar görmemiş gibi de görünmüyorlardı.

segments.text: Hardly had the results been published when other researchers began asking how the bees
segments.englishExplanation: As soon as their study was made public, other scientists immediately began inquiring how the bees...
segments.turkishExplanation: Sonuçlar yayımlanır yayımlanmaz, diğer araştırmacılar arıların bunu nasıl...

segments.englishExplanation: can manage to accomplish such a feat.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: An inverted structure used for emphasis to show that someone was completely unaware of what would happen.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Gelecekte yaşanacak bir olayın hiç beklenmediğini veya tahmin edilmediğini vurgulamak için kullanılan devrik yapı.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Little did she know that her discovery would change science forever.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Keşfinin bilimi sonsuza dek değiştireceğinden hiç haberi yoktu.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Not damaged, injured, or harmed by a difficult experience.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Zorlu bir deneyimden veya olaydan hiç zarar görmemiş, olumsuz etkilenmemiş olmak.
learningPoints.exampleEn: After spending the night in the storm, the hikers were none the worse for wear.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Fırtınada geceyi geçirdikten sonra dağcılar hiçbir zarar görmemiş durumdaydı.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: An inverted pattern showing that one action happened immediately after another.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir olayın hemen ardından başka bir olayın gerçekleştiğini belirten devrik zaman yapısı (-er -mez anlamı katar).
learningPoints.exampleEn: Hardly had I stepped outside when it started raining heavily.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Dışarı adımımı atar atmaz şiddetli bir yağmur başladı.

quiz.question: Hardly ______ the results been published when other researchers began asking how the bees manage it.

issues.message: Learning point ifadesi ("Hardly had... when...") segment 11'in transcript metninde literal olarak bulunamadı — pedagojik notation/çekim farkı olabilir, yanlış pozitif olasılığı var.
